author: Rabona
body:
Hey guys, I am looking for a team that scrims a lot (Every Other Day), and I am looking for a long term stay. I can not participate in the tournament.

My rushing skills are very on point, I am experienced with all the maps and know their strategies. Even though my KD is horrific, my PvP skills have went up in the recent months. I can also ninja bridge and staircase, and make a decent TnT Cannon.

If interested contact me my Skype is ;  mrpwnzmkw.

Regards,
Perhaps
